component.name: Caelum
component.summary: Live sky overlay for your desktop

description.p: Caelum turns your desktop background into a live sky: the real position of the sun, moon, planets and stars for your location, with clouds, rain and snow from live weather data.

ul.li: 240° panorama centred on your screen's real-world facing direction
Moon phase with correct crescent orientation for your latitude
Weekly and hourly forecast from Open-Meteo and MET Norway (no API key)
Compass support: hardware sensor, USB serial, or phone over the network
